name: JMLR
conferenceTrack: Papers can be presented at NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR through the joint Journal-to-Conference track, and at the AAAI journal track
note: The flagship open access journal of machine learning, founded when its editorial board left a commercial journal.

name: TMLR
conferenceTrack: Papers with a J2C, Featured or Outstanding certification can be presented at NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR
note: A fast open review journal on OpenReview that accepts papers for correctness and interest rather than perceived novelty.

name: TPAMI
full: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
note: The top IEEE journal for computer vision and pattern recognition, often carrying extended versions of CVPR and ICCV work.

name: IJCV
conferenceTrack: Papers can be presented at the AAAI journal track
note: A leading computer vision journal known for long, thorough articles and special issues tied to the main vision conferences.

name: AIJ
conferenceTrack: Papers can be presented at the IJCAI and AAAI journal tracks
note: The oldest general AI journal, covering knowledge representation, reasoning, planning, search and learning.

name: JAIR
conferenceTrack: Papers can be presented at the IJCAI and AAAI journal tracks
note: One of the first open access journals in computing, publishing across all areas of AI.

name: TACL
full: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics
submission: rolling, with monthly deadlines on the 1st of each month
conferenceTrack: Accepted papers can be presented at ACL, NAACL, EACL, AACL or EMNLP
note: The ACL journal with conference length papers and journal style review, whose papers are presented at the main ACL conferences.

name: CL
turnaround: about 46 days on average to first decision
conferenceTrack: Papers can be presented at ACL conferences such as ACL and EMNLP, and at the AAAI journal track
note: The flagship ACL journal for long articles and surveys in computational linguistics, open access since 2009.

name: NMI
note: A Nature family journal for high visibility machine learning, AI and robotics work, including its scientific and societal impact.

name: TSE
conferenceTrack: Journal-first papers can be presented at ICSE, FSE and other software engineering conferences
note: The oldest and most cited software engineering journal.

name: TOSEM
full: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
conferenceTrack: Journal-first papers can be presented at ICSE, FSE and other software engineering conferences
note: The premier ACM software engineering journal, with an emphasis on methods and rigorous evaluation.

name: EMSE
conferenceTrack: Journal-first papers can be presented at ICSE and other software engineering conferences
note: The main journal for empirical studies in software engineering, from mining repositories to controlled experiments.

name: TOPLAS
full: ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems
conferenceTrack: Journal-first papers can be presented at partner conferences such as POPL, PLDI, OOPSLA and ECOOP
note: The premier programming languages journal, covering language design, semantics, type systems, compilers and analysis.

name: FMSD
note: A journal for formal verification of hardware and software systems, often carrying extended CAV and FMCAD papers.

name: JAR
note: The main journal for automated and interactive theorem proving, SAT and SMT solving and their applications.

name: LMCS
note: A free diamond open access journal for logic in computer science, from semantics to verification.

name: JACM
note: The most prestigious general journal in computer science, publishing foundational results across theory and beyond.

name: SICOMP
note: A leading theory journal for algorithms and complexity, including special issues from STOC and FOCS.

name: TDSC
full: IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing
note: An IEEE journal covering security together with dependability and fault tolerance of computing systems.

name: TIFS
full: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
note: A leading security journal spanning biometrics, forensics, applied cryptography and network security.

name: TOPS
full: ACM Transactions on Privacy and Security
note: The main ACM security journal, known as TISSEC until 2016.

name: JoC
note: The flagship journal of the IACR, publishing full versions of major cryptography results.

name: TOCS
note: The premier systems journal, often carrying extended versions of SOSP and OSDI papers.

name: TODS
note: The premier ACM database journal, covering data management theory and systems.

name: VLDBJ
note: A leading database journal, frequently publishing extended versions of VLDB and SIGMOD papers.

name: TOCHI
conferenceTrack: Selected papers are invited to be presented at CHI
note: The flagship HCI journal of ACM SIGCHI.

name: ToN
full: IEEE Transactions on Networking (formerly IEEE/ACM Transactions on Networking)
note: The leading networking journal, published jointly with ACM from 1993 to 2024 and by IEEE alone since 2025.

name: CACM
submission: Research Highlights by nomination from SIGs and the editorial board, research articles rolling
note: The ACM flagship magazine, whose Research Highlights section reprints standout conference papers for a broad computing audience.
